We are the people’s champion

As a charity, we give people the knowledge and confidence they need to find their way forward and we work to challenge the underlying causes of their problems.

Featured advice

  • What the Autumn Budget 2026 means for you
  • Check what benefits you can get
  • Get help with the cost of living
  • Extra money and help PIP entitles you to
  • Grants and benefits to help you pay your energy bills

Volunteer with us
